title: phlegmariurus reflexus
intro: Phlegmariurus reflexus, commonly known as the reflexed polypody or reflexed walking fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the genus Phlegmariurus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus reflexus are primarily attributed to its ability to inhibit the release of histamine and other pro-inflammatory mediators, providing relief from allergic reactions and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
